g.text: Vanilla came to Ceylon in the 19th century through
the island’s botanic gardens. Today it grows in
home gardens in the hills of Kandy, Matale and
Nuwara Eliya, where every flower, open for a single
day, is still pollinated by hand. Steeped in alcohol,
which draws the fullest flavour from the cured
Level 26, East Tower, World Trade Center, Echelon Square, Colombo
